description: This PHP source file defines a class 'GlobalConfigSubscriber' which subscribes to HTTP request events to set certain configuration options (like internationalization and date formatting) based on request query parameters in an OrangeHRM plugin context.

classes.name: GlobalConfigSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to kernel request events to set configuration flags based on request parameters, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the kernel request event.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the kernel request event, extracting specific query parameters and updating configuration settings accordingly.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets a given configuration key to a value, with error handling that logs exceptions.
